w: A hospital, offered by the Mahalaxmi Charitable Trust to the BAPS, was equipped with the latest medical facilities by the Sanstha. The inaugural function took place in the presence of Swamishri, Chief Minister of Gujarat - Shri Keshubhai Patel and the State Health Minister - Shri Ashokbhai Bhatt. 'Pramukh Swami Hospital' was declared open amidst Vedic chantings by Swamishri and Shri Keshubhai Patel.
Swamishri's car broke down on the road towards Surat. (For details see photo story )
26 May to 4 June, 2002 : Sant Shibir
During his meal, a youth from Dungri-Timba came before Pramukh Swami Maharaj. As soon as he heard the name Dungri-Timba, Swamishri asked, "Whose son are you?"
"Haribhai's."
Swamishri immediately began to say, "Haribhai Govindbhai, Govindbhai Mathurbhai, originally from Sarsa..."

Seeing his family generations flowing from Swamishri's lips, the youth was bound to Swamishri by a cord of affection. After that Swamishri affectionately asked him to do satsang regularly, and the youth gave his word. What family-like affection Swamishri, who meets hundreds of devotees every day and travels to thousands of villages, has for countless such families! This is possible without effort only if one has a boundless sense of the glory of devotees.

At 11.40 am Swamishri departed by plane from Bhavnagar and landed at Surat airport at 12.00 noon. Thereafter Swamishri proceeded by road towards Navsari, reaching the BAPS mandir at 1.10 pm.

In the evening assembly, after Viveksagar Swami’s discourse on the Vachanamrut, Swamishri was welcomed with garlands offered by sadhus and devotees. Thereafter a welcome dance was performed by BAPS children and youths. Then the youths performed a drama based on the theme of atma-gnan from the Upanishads – Sanatkumar and Naradji. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
A small child came and said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Stay with me."
Swamishri said, "Remember God, and He will always be with you."
Living according to the command...
Swamishri was having darshan in Shastriji Maharaj's room. Sadhus, parshads and sadhaks were sitting along both walls of the room. There was a crowd for this darshan at the door too.

Meanwhile Mayur Ajmera, standing in front, said, "Shastriji Maharaj used to say that we are the bullocks of Akshar Purushottam. We too want to become bullocks of Akshar Purushottam. How can we become that?"

"Is that so!" Picking up the thread, Swamishri said, "You have joined in God's command, you have joined in seva, and you follow your dharma and rules, so we have become His devotees, that is, His bullocks. If we offer devotion and do seva according to His command, God is pleased. Just as a bullock is yoked however you yoke it, in the same way we too should act according to the command."
